LESSON: PROHIBITIONS IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.2: Prohibitions in Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Prohibitions in Islam
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why does Islam prohibit the use of intoxicants?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the types of intoxicants rampant in the society
2. explain the effects of intoxicants on the society
3. describe ways of curbing the use of intoxicants
4. appreciate the prohibition of intoxicants for the wellbeing of the society
